name: Indian-Style Mango Chutney
recipeIngredient: 2 large ripe mangoes, peeled and diced
1/4 tsp red chili flakes (adjust to taste)

recipeInstructions.text: Dice the peeled mangoes, finely chop the onion, and mince the garlic and ginger.
recipeInstructions.name: Prepare the Ingredients

recipeInstructions.text: In a saucepan, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the mustard seeds and cook until they start to pop.
recipeInstructions.name: Cook Aromatics

recipeInstructions.text: Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the pan. Cook for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally until the onions are soft and translucent.
recipeInstructions.name: Add Onions and Garlic

recipeInstructions.text: Stir in the grated ginger, ground cumin, ground coriander, turmeric, red chili flakes, and salt. Mix well and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
recipeInstructions.name: Add Spices and Mangoes

recipeInstructions.text: Add the diced mangoes, sugar, apple cider vinegar, and raisins to the saucepan. Stir everything together.
recipeInstructions.name: Combine with Mangoes

recipeInstructions.text: Reduce the heat to low and let the mixture simmer uncovered for about 25 minutes. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking.
recipeInstructions.name: Simmer the Chutney

recipeInstructions.text: The chutney will thicken as it cooks. If it becomes too thick, you can add a small amount of water.
recipeInstructions.name: Check Consistency

recipeInstructions.text: Once done, remove from heat and let the chutney cool. Transfer to a clean jar or container and refrigerate.
recipeInstructions.name: Cool and Store

recipeInstructions.text: Enjoy your mango chutney as a condiment alongside your favorite Indian dishes or snacks!
recipeInstructions.name: Serve

description:
This Indian-Style Mango Chutney is a delightful blend of sweet and tangy flavors, making it an ideal complement to a variety of dishes. The chutney is made with two large, ripe mangoes that provide natural sweetness, which is balanced beautifully with the tartness of apple cider vinegar. Combined with finely chopped onion and minced garlic, the chutney gains depth and richness, while freshly grated ginger adds a warm, spicy note.

Inspired by traditional Indian cuisine, this chutney also incorporates ground cumin and coriander, enhancing its aromatic profile and giving it a distinctive flavor. This condiment is versatile and can be served alongside curries, used as a dipping sauce for snacks, or drizzled over grilled meats to elevate your meal.

Enjoy this easy-to-make chutney that captures the essence of Indian flavors and adds a unique twist to your dining experience.
